description: This Java source file defines the class AccountNumberPreferencesHelper, which provides helper methods for managing account number preferences such as create, update, delete, retrieve, and verify account number formats via server API calls in the context of integration tests for the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: AccountNumberPreferencesHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing methods to manage account number preferences via REST API in integration tests.

methods.name: createClientAccountNumberPreference
methods.description: Creates a client account number preference by posting a JSON payload to the server API.

methods.name: createLoanAccountNumberPreference
methods.description: Creates a loan account number preference via server API call.

methods.name: createSavingsAccountNumberPreference
methods.description: Creates a savings account number preference via server API call.

methods.name: createGroupsAccountNumberPreference
methods.description: Creates a groups account number preference via server API call.

methods.name: createCenterAccountNumberPreference
methods.description: Creates a center account number preference via server API call.

methods.name: createAccountNumberPreferenceWithInvalidData
methods.description: Attempts to create an account number preference with invalid data to test error handling.

methods.name: updateAccountNumberPreference
methods.description: Updates an existing account number preference by ID.

methods.name: deleteAccountNumberPreference
methods.description: Deletes an account number preference by ID.

methods.name: getAccountNumberPreference
methods.description: Retrieves an account number preference by ID.

methods.name: verifyCreationOfAccountNumberPreferences
methods.description: Verifies the successful creation of account number preferences by checking each preference exists.

methods.name: verifyUpdationOfAccountNumberPreferences
methods.description: Verifies that an account number preference has been updated successfully.
